word-million.def: the number 1,000,000, or a thousand thousands

word-billion.def: the number 1,000,000,000, or a thousand millions

word-second-ordinal.def: coming right after the first one in order

word-third.def: coming right after the second one in order

word-fourth.def: coming right after the third one in order

word-fifth.def: coming right after the fourth one in order

word-sixth.def: coming right after the fifth one in order

word-seventh.def: coming right after the sixth one in order

word-eighth.def: coming right after the seventh one in order

word-ninth.def: coming right after the eighth one in order

word-tenth.def: coming right after the ninth one in order

word-quarter.def: one of four equal parts of something

word-third-fraction.def: one of three equal parts of something

word-fraction.def: a number that is a part of a whole, such as 1/2 or 3/4

word-percent.def: a part of every hundred; 50 of these means half

word-plus.def: a word you use for adding numbers together, shown by the sign +

word-minus.def: a word you use for taking one number away from another, shown by the sign −

word-times-sign.def: a word you use when you multiply one number by another, shown by the sign ×

word-divided-by.def: a phrase you use when you split one number into equal parts, shown by the sign ÷

word-equals.def: to have exactly the same value or amount as something else

word-sum.def: the number you get when you add numbers together

word-total.def: the whole amount when everything is added together

word-maximum.def: the biggest amount or number that is possible or allowed

word-minimum.def: the smallest amount or number that is possible or allowed

word-even-number.def: able to be divided by two with nothing left over

word-odd-number.def: not able to be divided by two without something left over

word-digit.def: any one of the written symbols from 0 to 9

word-calculator.def: a small machine that does math for you

word-equation.def: a math statement that shows two things are the same, using the sign =

word-triangle.def: a flat shape with three straight sides and three corners

word-rectangle.def: a flat shape with four straight sides and four right angles

word-angle.def: the amount of turn between two lines that meet at a point

word-area-math.def: the size of a flat surface, measured in square units

word-volume.def: the amount of space that a solid, liquid or gas takes up

word-meter.def: a basic unit of length equal to 100 centimeters

word-centimeter.def: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter

word-millimeter.def: a very small unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

word-kilometer.def: a unit of length equal to 1,000 meters

word-gram.def: a small unit of weight; a thousand of them make a kilogram

word-kilogram.def: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams

word-ton.def: a very heavy unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms

word-liter.def: a metric unit for measuring liquids, a little more than a quart

word-milliliter.def: a very small unit for measuring liquids, one thousandth of a liter

word-inch.def: a small unit of length equal to about two and a half centimeters

word-foot-unit.def: a unit of length equal to twelve inches, or about 30 centimeters

word-mile.def: a unit of distance equal to about 1.6 kilometers

word-pound-weight.def: a unit of weight equal to about 0.45 kilograms

word-number-phone.def: the series of digits you dial to call someone

word-counting.def: saying numbers one after another in order

word-first-of-all.def: a phrase you use to introduce the first thing you want to say
